title: Pentaryn Feature Riders
description: Does the riders dnd5e leaves to the player, from a small rules table keyed by feature identity and active only while the actor has the feature. Elemental Adept: 1s on the chosen type's damage dice of your spells count as 2 (core min2), and the damage tray starts with the target's resistance to that type ignored (the GM can switch it back; Apply keeps the choice). The card names what was applied under its dice row. Elemental Affinity: +CHA once per casting to a spell of your type. Potent Spellcasting (druid or cleric): +WIS to that class's cantrip damage. Healer: 1s rerolled on spell healing dice, and one Battle Medic activity that spends the TARGET's Hit Die and rolls it (1s rerolled) + PB; the active GM writes a target the player doesn't own, through a v14 user query. Also a -/+ on the character sheet's Hit Dice bar outside edit mode, one button per ray or dart on Scorching Ray and Magic Missile cards, one usage dialog per activity (a stale concentration replacement repaired), pick-one passive effects (the Transmuter's Stone: turning one benefit on turns the others off), and a Prepared / All spells switch on the Spells tab, which opens on the spells the character can cast today (remembered per user and character). Exposes game.pentaryn.riders.

recommends.reason: Ritual Adept's Rituals group, the Longer casts group, shared-uses badges and panel collapse live on the Argon HUD
the Cast Spell panel the Rituals and Longer casts groups are added to; Metamagic buttons skip its target picker; its spell tooltips get the spell's roll data

afterSync: First install: restart Foundry (module.json is read at startup), enable 'Pentaryn Feature Riders', then reload.
Audit feat riders per actor:  game.pentaryn.riders.report()
